I'm currently zeroing in on defining the core functionalities of this 5-Year Diary web application. The core focus remains on enabling comparisons of entries across specified years. My current focus is breaking down the core functionalities. I've pinpointed the key aspect: displaying entries from different years side-by-side on a single date view. My recent focus has been on the practical implementation, outlining each stage.
